content.title: Oscars 2026: Fran Drescher Defends Costar Timothée Chalamet Amid Controversial Ballet Comments
content.text: Oscars 2026: Fran Drescher Defends Costar Timothée Chalamet Amid Controversial Ballet Comments0 seconds of 3 minutes, 15 secondsVolume 0%Oscars 2026: Fran Drescher Defends Costar Timothée Chalamet Amid Controversial Ballet CommentsFran Drescher isn’t dancing around Timothée Chalamet’s controversial comments. The Nanny alum addressed her Marty Supreme costar’s recent remarks about ballet and opera as she walked the red carpet at the Elton John AIDS Foundation’s 2026 Oscars viewing party, theorizing that he may not have meant his words the way they were received. “I actually find him to be a very sweet and kind person, so I think that maybe he got a little too relaxed and maybe spoke out of turn,” she exclusively told E! News at the March 15 event. “He comes from a family of artists and he's been exposed to fine arts his whole life, so I really don't think, knowing him, that he meant for it to be received the way it did.” By the same token, Fran, 68, hoped the controversy would be a teachable moment for the 30-year-old on navigating life in the public eye.“You live, you learn, he's young and he's very much in the spotlight,” she continued. “I think you have to realize that the adoration that you get can easily turn on a dime. People can go for your jugular as easy as they will hail you, so that’s a life lesson learned.”Tommaso Boddi/WireImage; Kevin Mazur/Getty Images“If we can turn it into an opportunity to grow and learn,” she added, “then it was an experience worth having.” Of course, Oscars host Conan O’Brien had a bit of fun at Timothée’s expense during the ceremony, referencing the viral bit during his opening monologue as the actor—seated next to his girlfriend Kylie Jenner—giggled from his seat. “Security is extremely tight tonight,” Conan told the crowd inside the Dolby Theatre. “I'm told there's concerns about attacks from both the opera and ballet communities.”To see all the stars who dazzled at the 2026 Oscars, keep reading… --Reporting by Sharon CarpenterMike Coppola/Getty ImagesTeyana Taylorin Chanel and Tiffany and Co. jewelry.
